_comment: First production config of the rebuilt pipeline, 2026-08-19. Every line of printed text below is quoted verbatim from the artwork with its own colour, per the label-text-must-be-quoted rule: an invented label is clean, legible and plausible, so it survives a fast review in a way a garbled one does not. Bottle wording read off refs/product_tight.png; carton wording read off the corrected .ai dieline (Glutathione-Brightening-Serum-Skingenetix-box.ai), not from memory.
product_desc: Skingenetix Glutathione Brightening Radiant Glow Serum: a 30ml frosted white glass dropper bottle, straight-sided with square shoulders, fitted with a brushed silver-aluminium collar and a white rubber-bulb pipette. Reproduce the front label exactly as in the reference, every character verbatim and in these colours: the Skingenetix DNA-helix mark and the 'Skingenetix' wordmark in BLACK, spelled with a CAPITAL 'S' and the rest lower case, with no registered-trademark, copyright or any other symbol anywhere near it; a narrow vertical GOLD rule down the left of the text block; 'GLUTATHIONE BRIGHTENING' in BLACK bold capitals on two lines; 'RADIANT GLOW SERUM' in GOLD bold capitals on two lines; 'PREMIUM FORMULA' in BLACK light capitals; and '2% GLUTATHIONE  |  30ML' in small BLACK capitals at the base. The volume is 30ML - never 50ML. The sub-line is 'PREMIUM FORMULA' - never 'PROFESSIONAL TREATMENT'. Keep the frosted glass WHITE and neutral: do not tint it amber, gold, cream or yellow. The collar is brushed satin aluminium with a fine vertical grain, not a chrome mirror. PIPETTE PROPORTIONS, measured off the reference and frequently got wrong: the white rubber bulb is an ELONGATED CAPSULE, clearly taller than it is wide - about 1.6 times taller than wide. The bulb ALONE stands about ONE THIRD the height of the glass body, and roughly a fifth of the bottle's total height. The bulb plus the brushed collar together stand about TWO THIRDS the height of the glass body. Do not render a short, squat, stubby or ball-shaped bulb, and do not make the bulb the same height as the collar. THE BOTTLE LABEL CARRIES ONLY THE LINES LISTED ABOVE. It does NOT carry the benefit triplet, 'ALL SKIN TYPES', or any ingredient list - those belong to the carton only, and printing them on the bottle is wrong. BRAND ACCENT COLOUR: this product's brand colour is GOLD - a warm matte antique gold. Wherever a shot calls for a brand colour, brand gradient or accent glow, build it from that gold and warm neutrals. Never purple, violet, navy, blue, pink or green. Keep the frosted glass NEUTRAL WHITE under every lighting setup: warm light and gold surroundings light the bottle, they do not dye it.
_packaging_desc_help: Written face by face because a model renders a box in one colour unless told otherwise, and because the carton carries far more text than the bottle. Source: the corrected dieline. The carton is ONE box with two differently-coloured large faces - it is not two product variants.
packaging_desc: The product carton is a tall slim rectangular box, 41 x 41 x 99mm, noticeably taller than it is wide. It has TWO large faces in DIFFERENT colours and they meet at crisp edges, each colour holding right up to the edge. The GOLD FACE is matte metallic gold and carries, from top to bottom: the Skingenetix DNA-helix mark and 'Skingenetix' wordmark in WHITE; a narrow vertical WHITE rule down the left of the text block; 'GLUTATHIONE BRIGHTENING' in BLACK bold capitals on two lines; 'RADIANT GLOW SERUM' in WHITE bold capitals on two lines; 'ANTIOXIDANT DEFENSE' / 'DARK SPOT CARE' / 'FRESH COMPLEXION' on three lines in BLACK light capitals; then 'PREMIUM FORMULA' in BLACK light capitals, 'ALL SKIN TYPES' small in WHITE, and two small BLACK lines reading 'GLUTATHIONE 2%  |  BRIGHTENING PEPTIDES' and 'STABLE VITAMIN C  |  30ML'. The SILVER FACE is matte metallic silver - a brushed pale silver, NOT white cardboard and NOT a mirror - and carries the identical layout and identical wording, but with the DNA-helix mark, the wordmark, the vertical rule, 'RADIANT GLOW SERUM' and 'ALL SKIN TYPES' in GOLD instead of white, while 'GLUTATHIONE BRIGHTENING', the three benefit lines, 'PREMIUM FORMULA' and the two small ingredient lines stay BLACK. The narrow side panels are printed in the same gold and silver and carry small paragraphs of ingredient and directions text, too small to read at this distance - render them as fine unreadable print, and never as the literal words 'body copy' or any other placeholder. The volume on every panel reads '30ML' - never 50ML. FINISH, and the references disagree with this so follow the words: the real carton stock is MATTE METALLIC with a luxury satin finish, specified on the dieline as 'Mat Metalic Gold' and 'Mat Metalic Silver'. The photographed carton references were shot glossy and read as polished foil; that is the photography, not the product. Render a soft brushed sheen with a broad diffuse falloff across each face, never a mirror, never a reflective gold bar, never chrome. PRINT NOTHING THAT IS NOT LISTED ABOVE. Every word on this carton is specified in this description; do not invent, translate, paraphrase or add any further wording, claims or ingredient names on any face.
_refs_local_help: product_tight.png ONLY, and deliberately so. Luma reads refs[0] and nothing else. pack_full.png was excluded on 2026-08-19: its bottle still reads 'PROFESSIONAL TREATMENT' where the corrected render reads 'PREMIUM FORMULA', and its carton reads 50ML, so it contradicts product_tight on two lines at once. A reference that disagrees with the brief wins, because reference-lock is faithful.
_refs_packaging_help: box_artwork_flat.png leads. It is flat artwork rather than a photograph, but it is the only carton reference with the corrected 30ML wording, and it is the one Luma will see. The two photographed faces follow for perspective, edge geometry and finish. KNOWN AND ACCEPTED: both photographed cartons predate the 30ML fix and still read 50ML, and both are rendered glossier than the real satin-metallic stock, so expect some packaging candidates to show the wrong volume and a mirror sheen.
_gemini_used_today: Gemini calls already spent today across ALL products; the cap is 250 and nbp_pro and nbp_flash share it. The health check spent 2 (one each). Preflight also reads the ledger and takes whichever number is higher.
